errors.text: The proposed heating rate of 10–50 K/s conflicts with the target protocol of 1 K/s and could substantially change kinetically controlled segregation and evaporation.

The simulation intervention is internally contradictory: suppressing surface-diffusion barriers would enhance diffusion, whereas the falsification rule describes surface diffusion as artificially constrained.
The critical threshold is left as a broad 600–800 K interval rather than identifying the experimentally relevant onset near 673 K.
